newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - German gold issue ignites Bund volatility.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - German gold issue ignites Bund volatility.

text.p: A row between the Bundesbank and the German government over plans to revalue gold reserves dimmed prospects for a single European currency, sending Bund options' volatility higher, traders said on Thursday.
The German government plans to increase receipts to the national treasury through the revaluation, but the Bundesbank said the scheme could undermine the euro from the start.
